title: Cloud and control plane
status: AUTHORED. The domain where a web finding becomes an estate finding.

atom_notes.A02: the jump from an app principal to an infrastructure principal is the whole class
atom_notes.A15: configuration divergence is where cloud exposure lives, not in code
atom_notes.A11: container and IaC supply chain is part of the estate
atom_notes.A08: enumeration of what exists is the first step and is itself exposure
atom_notes.A07: metadata and token endpoints are reachable resources that can be exhausted or abused

required_cells.why: inventory what exists before testing permissions, or you test nothing
permission probing needs automation and a read only discipline
escalation is proven with a path, not with a finding name
a permission list is not a proof, an action is
cloud findings need blast radius framing
policy retest after a fix, the least practised step here

entries.name: Instance metadata probing (curl)
entries.role: The classic SSRF to credential path, tested with nothing but a request
preconditions: a server side fetch primitive in scope
oracle: role credentials returned by the metadata endpoint

entries.note: IMDSv2 changes the test: a token request first. If the fetch cannot set a header, the class is gone. Say so rather than reporting a false positive.

tree.q: Are you outside the estate or holding a credential?
tree.why: The two positions have almost nothing in common. Outside means exposure. Inside means permission paths.

branches.action: look for the services that do not require a credential and are meant to be internal: buckets, metadata proxies, admin panels, storage listing
enumerate what it can do before using it. auth can-i list, or the provider equivalent, then map to paths
branches.oracle: an action the credential should not permit

branches.action: probe the metadata service with a token request first. IMDSv2 means no header equals no finding
branches.oracle: credentials returned, or a token then credentials

branches.action: run a posture scanner with read only credentials, then rank by blast radius not by count
